title: 彭博Man Deep：前沿实验室收入口径之争，净收入才是关键？
speaker: Man Deep Singh

segments.en: Well, I mean, anthropic, you know, gives us a gross number and they went from 9 billion in ARR to close to 80 billion.
segments.zh: Anthropic给出的是毛收入数字，年度经常性收入从90亿增长到接近800亿。

segments.en: Now, what these frontier labs do is they run their models on cloud providers like Amazon, Google or Microsoft.
segments.zh: 这些前沿实验室的做法是，在亚马逊、谷歌或微软等云服务商上运行模型。

segments.en: So in the case of OpenAI, their arrangement is such that Microsoft takes, you know, the cloud cost of running their models as well as a separate fee that, you know, they have to pay Microsoft.
segments.zh: 以OpenAI为例，微软会收取运行模型的云成本，以及一笔单独的费用。

segments.en: So if they're counting it as net, it makes sense that, you know, it's not 70 billion and 50 billion.
segments.zh: 所以如果按净收入计算，那就不是700亿或500亿了。

segments.en: Like I said, the prior trajectory, they gave a 40 billion dollar number back in July and these companies have been adding, you know, 6 to 7 billion in revenue per month.
segments.zh: 就像我说的，之前的轨迹是7月给出400亿的数字，而这些公司每月增加60到70亿收入。

segments.en: So that's where the trajectory really matters and what is the monthly net revenue look like.
segments.zh: 所以轨迹才是关键，月度净收入究竟是多少。

segments.en: And I think we probably need some clarification from the company.
segments.zh: 我认为我们可能需要公司方面做出一些澄清。
